purpose: Pre-registered Round 7 Operations Research supplement addressing simulated AE and three-referee panel critiques while keeping all previously sealed closed-loop runs (1,376 active runs, 72-task confirm_fresh_72, 24-scramble state audit, and 9,796 predecessor runs) and SC-OLH-KG/v2_or execution code 100% untouched.

R7_1_closedloop_frontier_contract_and_or.panel: Active 86 target tasks (24 Inventory_CrossHorizon, 24 Queueing_CrossHorizon, 14 OPSD_EuroGrid, 24 Traffic_Ingolstadt), 2 paired streams per task (172 runs per arm), identical search budget (N0=8, N=60, m_batch=2; 136 search calls) and identical guarded three-slot clean-up contract (112, 128, 140) unless explicitly varied by the factor under test.
primary_frontier_arms: SCBO-3Slot (raw-space Sobol trust-region constrained BO + identical 3-slot clean-up)
GP-FTA-LatentNEI-3Slot (faithful latent-integrated noisy expected improvement, M_NEI=32 joint QMC draws recomputing feasible sampled incumbent per draw)
RGPE-on-Psi-3Slot (ranking-weighted GP ensemble on shared psi + source DCT warm-start + identical 3-slot clean-up)
WarmStart-MTGP-KG-3Slot (Poloczek-Wang-Frazier style source-mean plus target-discrepancy GP on psi + gate-power KG + identical 3-slot clean-up)
contract_and_budget_arms: GP-FTA-AllowUnvisited (relaxing D_N-only eligibility to allow unvisited posterior candidates in Slots 0 and 2)
GP-FTA-DirectMaxU (parameter-free shortlist maximization of working-model cascade utility U_m(S) without heuristic 0.55/0.02 thresholds)
GP-FTA-LongSearch-k0 (re-allocating budget to N=100 search steps = 216 search calls + curtailed k*=0 verification (72, 82, 90) = 244 max calls)

terminal_gate_sensitivity.evaluated_on: 172 reconstructed terminal GP-FTA-ECKG search states across all 86 tasks
designs: Gate-k1-Curtailed: (112, 128, 140), exact sequential binomial curtailment stopping at v_obs >= k*+1 or v_obs + (K_i - m) <= k*

high_budget_reference_oracle.evaluated_on: All 86 target tasks (zero interaction with online runs)
high_budget_reference_oracle.design: 480 diverse policies per task (multi-scale DCT, source templates, Sobol, and Powell/coordinate local search) screened at 16 replications and audited on exact task audit streams (2,000 DES / 8,000 OPSD draws) to estimate feasible reference optimum J_oracle (p_audit <= 0.05) and certifiable reference optimum J_cert_oracle (p_audit <= 0.02).

R7_1_closedloop_frontier_contract_and_or.inference_hierarchy: Fixed-sequence hierarchy on standardized pooled DES status-quo loss (n=72 tasks): (Step 1) four-comparator Holm test against external frontier arms; (Step 2) paired tests against contract/budget counterfactuals; supplemented by robustness checks using EC-KG SD standardization, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, and L_comp penalty weights {1, 2, 5, 10}.

decision_calibration_and_pillars_on_conf.panel: 72 unseen DES tasks from confirm_fresh_72 (n=9 shared observations, 32 disjoint held-out policies x 400 ground-truth replications each)
metrics: slot0_gate_power_rmse (RMSE between predicted posterior gate power and true BinomCDF(1; 112, p_true))
feasibility_auroc (AUROC for classifying held-out policies with p_true <= 0.05)
top1_selection_true_cascade_gain (true expected Slot-0 clean-up saving of the held-out policy maximizing predicted gate-weighted saving)
meta_baselines: ABLR-on-Psi (Perrone et al. 2018 empirical-Bayes shared basis)
four_pillar_ablations: Psi-GenericBlackBox (simulator-free control profile quantiles, ramps, and public forecast moments)

frozen_state_latent_nei_and_sensitivity.states: 24 production states (Queueing and Traffic, t00..t05, steps 0 and 59) across R=24 independent 256x1024 Sobol scrambles
comparisons: Sensitivity over gate threshold {0.40, 0.55, 0.70}, release threshold {0.50, 0.65, 0.80}, and HVD buffer {0.15, 0.35, 0.55}

external_simopt_tandem_cntnv_benchmark.description: Published-literature stochastic constrained simulation optimization testbed combining multi-stage tandem queueing + continuous newsvendor capacity allocation (Koenig & Law 1985; Hong, Luo & Nelson 2015; Eckman et al. 2023 SimOpt conventions), 6 source tasks (d_s in {24, 32}) -> 24 target tasks (d_t in {48, 64}, 2 streams = 48 runs/arm), using strictly generic black-box control-profile summary psi_generic (zero simulator-specific fluid equations).
